drafted_from: workflow row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json, the shipped rule row open-job-posts in tools/workflows/read-data/candidate-rules.json and tools/workflows/test/outreach-recipes.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:reach-companies-with-a-long-open-job-post: I help small companies hire operations managers faster, send from hello@example.com in America/Chicago, record it under product-hiring-help, and start with the job posts my job board connection gives."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Set up a separate sending address on a domain that is not your main one (like hello@example.com) and note its time zone; take the job posts from your job board connection as items (each post with its company, role, address, posted_at and employees).

2. Say "Run workflow:reach-companies-with-a-long-open-job-post" with offer, from, time_zone, product_id and the items. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps find, read-post, problems, keep, style, write, judge, pace, send, record, outcomes, measure.

3. At find, only posts open 21 days or more at companies of 10 to 200 people are kept (the shipped rule row; your own source_row replaces it, the rules are never loosened to get more), each scored by the signals it matches.

4. Read the four-sentence messages it wrote (role and days open, biggest problem in the post's own words, what that costs, one low-effort question) and approve the addresses; only approved messages go out, from the separate address, at the pace of the inbox.
5. Replies come to you to answer; bounced addresses are suppressed; the measure step counts found, sent, replied, call booked and customer by signal so the next run knows which signal pays.

worked_examples.title: A post open 43 days at a company of 40 people is kept with both signals
worked_examples.ask: Find companies whose job post has been open three weeks or more and who might need my help.

input.offer: I help small companies hire operations managers faster.

worked_examples.given: From tools/workflows/test/outreach-recipes.test.mjs: a post at a company of 40 people posted 2026-09-20, judged on 2026-11-02 (43 days later) against the shipped row open-job-posts passes its keep rule (10 to 200 people, open 21 days or more) and matches the signals open-a-month (weight 2) and open-three-weeks (weight 1), so its score is 3.
